item.title: Windows 11 25H2 Official ISO Finally Drops! Microsoft Really Made a 'Minor Patch' Version This Time
item.description: Microsoft finally released the Windows 11 25H2 official ISO. While it's just a continuation of 24H2, the grown-to-7GB size makes people curious. From download to installation, including all the pitfalls, this article helps you figure out whether this 'not-so-major' update is worth upgrading to.
